Definition: Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess
BiblicalUsage: Two different people carry the name Noadiah, and Scripture keeps them apart. In Ezra 8:33 Noadiah son of Binnui is a Levite who helps weigh the silver and gold brought back to the house of God, and in Nehemiah 6:14 a prophetess named Noadiah is among those who tried to frighten Nehemiah while he rebuilt the wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name is not a character: the same name can belong to a faithful Levite and to a false prophetess, and God judges each person by their own deeds. That is why I never let a name do the work of a life.
